tuning.objective: mean total cost per series-day over normal, unreliable and tuning-set disruptions, days 77-90

meta.currency_note: Assumed unit economics applied to (normalized) volumes; not real money.

demand_bounds.note: Reference demand on stockout days replaced by observed sales (lower) or recovery x 1.25 (upper).

audit.note: Faults are injected into real benchmark candidates; truth uses the simulator state at that decision.

hypotheses.statement: Better forecast accuracy does not necessarily produce lower decision cost.
hypotheses.rule: supported if the most accurate model on observed sales is not the lowest-cost model and their paired cost difference CI excludes zero; partially supported if the models differ but the CI includes zero

hypotheses.statement: Under unreliable data, validation lowers unsafe decisions and total cost including governance.
hypotheses.rule: supported if P5a executes fewer unsafe decisions than P3 and the paired cost CI is below zero; partially supported if only one holds

hypotheses.statement: Under normal operations the validation layer's net cost change is within +/-2%.
hypotheses.rule: supported if the relative paired difference CI lies within [-2%, +2%]; not supported otherwise

hypotheses.statement: Mean-CVaR optimization lowers CVaR90 at an expected-cost increase below 5%.
hypotheses.rule: supported if it holds in all three conditions; partially if in some

hypotheses.statement: Hourly-profile recovery reduces error and bias on artificially censored days.
hypotheses.rule: supported if both MAE and absolute bias are lower than treating observed sales as demand
